result.markdown:
# Transport Failure in Grand Tunis Affecting Multiple Sites

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-02-C`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of LINK_LOS on the shared fiber link at the exact onset of the site outages. Maintenance, configuration changes, and external events were all checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 16:50 to 2026-09-22 00:29
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 16:50
- **Affected:** S-TUN-012, S-TUN-014, S-TUN-015, LNK-TUN-02-C

## Summary

A fiber link loss on LNK-TUN-02-C caused a complete outage on three connected sites in Grand Tunis.

Sites S-TUN-012, S-TUN-014, and S-TUN-015 experienced a total outage starting at 16:50 on 2026-09-21 and recovered around midnight after approximately 7.5 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 15:41: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-012 [ALM-000463]
- 2026-09-21 16:10: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm cleared on S-TUN-012 [ALM-000463]
- 2026-09-21 16:50: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on shared fiber link LNK-TUN-02-C [ALM-000472, T5]
- 2026-09-21 16:51: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-014, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-015 [ALM-000473, ALM-000474, ALM-000475, T2, T5]
- 2026-09-22 00:26: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-02-C [ALM-000472]
- 2026-09-22 00:27: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-014 [ALM-000473]
- 2026-09-22 00:28: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000475]
- 2026-09-22 00:29: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-012 [ALM-000474]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-012, S-TUN-014, and S-TUN-015 went down simultaneously following a fiber link failure on LNK-TUN-02-C at 16:50 on 2026-09-21. [T2, T5, ALM-000472, ALM-000473, ALM-000474, ALM-000475]
- No configuration changes, maintenance windows, or external events occurred during the incident timeframe on the affected nodes. [T4, T6, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-C: confirmed. Directly evidenced by a critical LINK_LOS alarm on the shared fiber link and subsequent SITE_DOWN alarms on all dependent sites without concurrent changes or maintenance. [T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, ALM-000472]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000463: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-TUN-012 cleared well before the incident started and affected only a single site parameter unrelated to total site loss.
- ANM-000292: Anomalies on S-TUN-011 belong to a separate event (ALR-0023) and are not part of this cluster.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the physical fiber link LNK-TUN-02-C for potential cuts, degradation, or splice box issues.
- Review aggregation router AGG-TUN-02 interface stability and error logs.

## Sources

- `ALM-000463`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-012, raised 2026-09-21 15:41, cleared 2026-09-21 16:10

- `ALM-000473`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-TUN-014, raised 2026-09-21 16:51, cleared 2026-09-22 00:27

- `T2`: get_alarms(start=2026-09-21 15:00, end=2026-09-21 19:00, node_ids=['S-TUN-012', 'S-TUN-014', 'S-TUN-015'], include_descendants=True) -> 4 alarm(s) on S-TUN-012, S-TUN-014, S-TUN-015 and nodes below, 2026-09-21 15:00 to 2026-09-21 19:00: 3 critical, 1 minor; 0 active at asked_at (2026-09-22 08:38).
